newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks in mixed consolidation after highs.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks in mixed consolidation after highs.

text.p: MADRID, June 26 (Reuter) 1130 GMT - Madrid stock indices were slightly lower at midsession on Thursday, with some mixed profit-taking helping the market to consolidate before setting out for new highs, dealers said.
The Ibex-35 was down 10.0 points, 0.14 percent, to 6,903.17.
"It's logical for us to see a correction after continued highs, although it will be a temporary thing and soon we'll be back on the uptrend," said a dealer.
Banks were still strong, Popular rising 1.07 percent to 34,470 pesetas and BBV up 0.92 percent to 12,100 pesetas.
Retailers were still gaining on buoyant consumption expectations, although some analysts thought the sector was beginning to look overpriced.
Bankinter added 0.96 percent to 26,260 pesetas after announcing a first interim dividend of 168 pesetas per share.
Amper was off highs after its recent run and after announcing that 1997 profits are expected to be in line with last year's figures.
